_note: PHASE 2 MEASURED SET. These 8 questions were written by reading the 6 fermentation cards in data/new_drop BEFORE any search was run, and before either index existed. Their sha256 is locked in out/questions.lock.json on the first measured run; run_hitrate.py refuses to run against an edited file unless --relock is passed, so the hit-rate cannot quietly become a measure of question-tuning. 5 of the 8 (q1-q5) depend on a row inside an ingredient table; the requirement is at least 3.

_schema.question: the question as asked
_schema.expected_recipe_id: recipe_id of the card that answers it - known BEFORE searching
_schema.expected_section: which part of that card holds the answer
_schema.depends_on_table_row: true when the answer is a row inside the ingredient table
_schema.known_answer: the answer as written on the card, for the write-up
_schema.answer_must_contain: strings that MUST appear in a retrieved chunk for it to count as a hit. Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant, so '18 g' also matches '18g'. This is what makes a hit objective rather than a section-label guess.

questions.question: How much fine sea salt goes into the 2kg country sourdough?
What hydration percentage does the 2kg country sourdough run at?
questions.known_answer: 76% - 760 g water against 1000 g total flour

questions.question: How much gochugaru goes into the napa cabbage kimchi?
questions.known_answer: 60 g, which is 6% of the trimmed cabbage weight

questions.question: How much coarse sea salt do the half-sour dill pickles need?
questions.known_answer: 24 g, which is 2.4% of the cucumber weight

questions.question: How many grams of live kefir grains go into one litre of milk?
questions.known_answer: 50 g of grains to 1000 g of milk, which is 5%

questions.question: How long does the red cabbage sauerkraut ferment, and at what temperature?
questions.known_answer: three to four weeks at 18 C

questions.question: Is the napa cabbage kimchi safe for someone with a shellfish allergy?
questions.known_answer: No - it contains salted shrimp paste (saeujeot) and fish sauce

questions.question: At what temperature and for how long is the white rice miso fermented?
questions.known_answer: 28 C for four to eight weeks

generation_unanswerable: What is the calorie and macronutrient breakdown per 100 g of the napa cabbage kimchi?
What is the live probiotic CFU count per gram of the milk kefir?
What baker's percentage of caraway seed does the napa cabbage kimchi use?
_unanswerable_note: The first is nutrition data, which appears on no card. The second sounds like it belongs on a kefir card but is never stated. The third is the hardest kind of absence: caraway seed IS a real row on the red cabbage sauerkraut card, but the kimchi card has no caraway at all - so a model that retrieves on-topic chunks and pattern-matches across cards will invent a percentage. A refusal set made only of nutrition questions probes one kind of absence; this one probes three.

bonus.question: How much fine sea salt goes into the 2kg country sourdough, and at what point in the mix is it added?
bonus.note: The precision/completeness probe required by the bonus. The structure-aware ingredient chunk holds 'Fine sea salt | 18 g | 1.8%' with its title and table header, so it answers 'how much' exactly - and carries no method prose, so it cannot say when. The sourdough method deliberately states that the salt is held back until after the forty-minute autolyse, which lives in a different chunk entirely. The looser baseline window may straddle the table/method boundary and answer both halves less precisely.
